messages:
sasha_support: FYI customer INC-3821 reports invoice showing ~18% more billed tokens than dashboard served tokens. They say served tokens in UI ~1.2M but invoice line ~1.42M. Attached screenshots and invoice id INV-2022-11.
liam_eng: can you paste the customer request example & the exact model/route they used? also whether they used dedicated/dedicated-pinned model or hosted multi-tenant.
sasha_support: route: /v1/generate, model: redwood/opt-6.7b, plan: hosted, options: continuous_batcher=v2 enabled, prefetch.enabled=true. Customer says majority calls are short prompts with many repeated prefixes.
priya_billing: INV-2022-11 found. charging window 2024-10-20 -> 2024-11-19. I'll pull raw metering rows but need the trace id or sample request ids to cross-check.
sasha_support: pasted two sample request ids from customer: r-9f3a and r-9f3b. They included the original prompt and a screenshot of the served token count from the Console request view.
noah_sre: quick note — deploy-bot flagged a continuous_batcher rollout at 2024-10-22 that changed prefetch batching behavior. @liam_eng could that affect metering? :thinking:
liam_eng: yes. cbatch v2 changed prefetch scheduling and now issues warmup prefetches per-shard. Previously we did a dedupe at the prefetch stage. New behavior can generate more prefetch RPCs that hit metering earlier in the pipeline.
liam_eng: tl;dr hypothesis: billing meter counts token consumption at ingress (when prefetch request is issued) while "served tokens" in Console is computed after KV/prefix cache lookup and de-duping. If prefetch tokens are billed before cache hit dedupe, you'll see invoice > served.
sasha_support: can we repro quickly? customer says pattern: repeated identical short prefixes that should be cached -> so many prefetches but actual served tokens low.
liam_eng: repro steps I used locally:
```
# simulate warmup prefetch that used to be deduped
export PREFETCH_ENABLED=true
export CONTINUOUS_BATCHER_V2=true
# send N short identical requests
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hi","stream":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' ; done
```
Look at metering events in logs: search for metering.event = "ingress_token_report" vs "served_token_report".
liam_eng: I see in my run: ingress_token_report = 120 tokens total, served_token_report = 22 tokens. Billing currently sums ingress side for invoice.
priya_billing: thanks. that matches a ~5x delta which fits their case size. If confirmed we should issue a billing adjustment for INV-2022-11 and prevent future double-counting.
noah_sre: found the deploy bot entry: deploy-bot: "cbatcher/v2 rollout -> prefetch per-shard change" @liam_eng linking: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rollouts/9821
sasha_support: customer asked for a timeline and whether this affects other accounts.
liam_eng: impact surface: any account with prefetch.enabled=true + continuous_batcher_v2 rollout during billing window may see extra billed tokens. Not everyone uses prefetch. We should run a query to find accounts with both flags true and counts delta > 10%.
priya_billing: running query now against billing_events table. snippet:
```
SELECT customer_id, sum(metered_tokens) as billed, sum(served_tokens) as served
FROM billing_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2024-10-20' AND '2024-11-19'
AND prefetch_enabled = TRUE AND continuous_batcher_v2 = TRUE
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING billed > served * 1.1;
```
priya_billing: preliminary: ~12 accounts show >10% delta, INV-2022-11 is in that set.
sasha_support: customer wants a quick explanation we can send them.
liam_eng: short explanation to send: "We discovered a billing mismatch caused by our recent continuous_batcher v2 rollout. Prefetch/warmup requests are recorded at ingress for billing, while the Console's served token metric reports tokens after cache/prefix dedupe. In some workloads (many short, identical prefixes) prefetch tokens are billed but not counted as served, creating an apparent overcharge. We're auditing affected invoices and will issue adjustments."
priya_billing: action items:
- issue credit for INV-2022-11 (I will start a manual adjustment)
- run full audit for Oct 15 -> Nov 20
- add a temporary tag to metering pipeline so we can filter prefetch-originated token reports
liam_eng: engineering fixes:
- short-term: revert the per-shard prefetch scheduling to previous dedupe behavior (hotfix branch ready) or update metering to attribute tokens only after cache dedupe
- long-term: unify billing meter point to post-cache dedupe when feasible, and add explicit prefetch_billed_tokens metric
noah_sre: I'll schedule a rollback/patch window and post in #eng-oncall. low-risk but we should monitor latency/coldstart regressions.
sasha_support: thanks all. I'll reply to customer with the explainer and say we're issuing a credit and doing a platform fix. Will follow-up in this thread with customer response.
deploy-bot: build #hotfix/cbatch-dedupe deployed to staging at 2024-11-21T03:17:10Z :rocket:
liam_eng: after hotfix we should re-run the billing query to confirm deltas shrink. I'll also add a dashboard: prefetch_ingress_tokens vs post_cache_served_tokens by customer.
priya_billing: opened billing adjustment ticket ADJ-556, will update when credit posted.
sasha_support: closing loop for now, customer acknowledged provisional credit. tagging for follow-up: @liam_eng @priya_billing @noah_sre. Thanks :pray:
